_note: 1.90.0 (owner-approved planning/DRAFT_kerja_club.md §3): what clubs do for the whole campus, whether {{user}} is a member or not (feature clubwork). clubs: by club key (tools/common.py load_clubs 'key'), the Clubs directory's 'For the campus' line. The club stalls (cold remedies, the Saturday bake, the potion table, Greenwick's herbs) are data/shop.json rows with 'club' (and when / day / from / to). newspaper: issued Monday 07:00 (not in a break week); keep = days a printed rumour lives longer, and it never fizzles; ghost = the Newspaper's ghost-story pieces (lore). bake: the Saturday bake's good batch chance (percent, roll100 by day). client (1.92.0, §4.7): once a week a pct% chance, when {{user}} is in one of these service clubs, that a student who is not a member comes to the club on one of its service days for one of its asks (filled from gift_prefs {thing}, the calendar {event}, a subject {subject}; never the same ask twice in the NPC's last 20); match = a regex on the NPC's haunts and tastes that doubles the weight; window_min = minutes after the service opens that the client arrives. committee: the events the Festival Committee runs (its Notice Board posting, with the event's chances as the programme). snow: the morning after snow (wxFits 'snow'), campus walks take slow percent more until clear; walks with an end in far keep it until far_until. Weather effects Full only.

clubs.Divination: Posts tomorrow's skies on the Notice Board every morning at 07:00, right about three times in four.
clubs.Newspaper: Prints the Academy Newspaper every Monday at 07:00: last week's results, the rumour everyone is repeating, the week ahead and a ghost story.
clubs.Medical Centre Volunteers: In flu weeks, hands out free cold remedies at the Medical Centre, 07:00–19:00, one each.
clubs.Cooking: Bakes in the Canteen kitchen on Saturdays, 15:00–17:00: honey bread when it works, free failures when it does not.
clubs.Brewing: Sells the week's surplus simple potions with the Alchemy Circle in the Potion Halls on Saturdays, 14:00–18:00.
clubs.Alchemy: Sells the week's surplus simple potions with the Brewing Club in the Potion Halls on Saturdays, 14:00–18:00.
clubs.Gardening: Supplies Greenwick's with fresh-cut reagent herbs from spring to autumn.
clubs.Groundskeeping: Clears the main paths of snow before the seven o'clock bell; the far grounds stay deep until the afternoon.
clubs.Festival Committee: Posts the programme of every festival it runs on the Notice Board ten days ahead.
